snippet.title: Union of Gnomes — 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Union of Gnomes is ready for the final battle for freedom! 
We present to you the full game with a 35% discount on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 
Goodbye, Early Access 😏
